steps.player: Well that's a shame because I really need your help to make some chicken cages!

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: I'm sorry, but the most I can manage today is simple trading...however, if I was to get some medicine say, I could be persuaded to do you a small favour!

steps.player: Oh I see, you need me to do you a favour?

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: Well, just one small favour...and then I'll do you a small favour.

options.text: Oh, no not another favour...I just can't do another one!

steps.player: Oh, no not another favour...I just can't do another one!

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: Well, I'm sorry about that...but I just can't work when I'm feeling so ill.

options.text: Ok, I guess one good turn deserves another.

steps.text: Horvik takes the steel bars.

steps.player: Ok, I guess one good turn deserves another.

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: Well that's jolly decent of you my friend. I need some medicine, could you get me some herbal tincture and breathing salts, that should solve my ailments!

steps.player: Well, hopefully, I'll be right back, but you never know, it might take longer!

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: That's great! However, I must warn you, it'll be a lot easier for me to simply adjust some existing pigeon cages. If you could get me five or so of those, that would help a lot.

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: But first things first, bring me the medicine!

the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-hor.speaker: Horvik
the-various-favours-are-asked-asking-hor.text: Hello, do you need any help?

options.text: What was I supposed to be doing?

steps.player: What was I supposed to be doing?

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: Please can you get me some medicine? I need herbal tincture and a pot of breathing salts. Also, get me five or so of those pigeon cages that they have over in Ardougne so that I can convert them into chicken

steps.speaker: Horvik
steps.text: cages.

options.text: Talk about One Small Favour.

steps.player: Horvik is ill, I need breathing salts and herbal tincture.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: No problem!
The Apothecary shows you the herbal tincture.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: There you do! There's your herbal tincture!

steps.player: Wow, that was surprisingly easy! Fantastic, thanks very much.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: No problem, pleased to help.

steps.player: Oh...but...what about the breathing salts...

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Oh, yes, breathing salts...erm, just let me look around. I'm sure I have some around here somewhere.

steps.player: Ok...

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Yep, here they are....
The Apothecary gets out a jar of breathing salts.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Oh blimey...I've dropped the pot and smashed it!

steps.player: That's ok, just hand over the breathing salts.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Oh no, you don't understand. They're ruined. They're supposed to be kept in an airtight container and this was my last one.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: I can't order any more in until I have a new airtight container. And they were a top selling item as well.

steps.player: I just knew this wasn't going to be easy! So you can't get any more breathing salts?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: No, I can..I can order plenty, but they'll lose their effectiveness. I need an airtight pot to keep them in.

steps.player: Where would you get one of those from?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: I've no idea really, this pot was a family heirloom. I guess you'd have to get a new one made?

steps.player: Where could I do that?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: You could try Tassie Slipcast over at the Barbarian Village. She's a potter there and may be able to make one. But mind, it has to be air tight.

options.text: Oh, no way am I going to the Barbarian Village.

steps.player: Oh, no way am I going to the Barbarian Village.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: I understand...they're all barbarians over there.

options.text: I guess I can go to the Barbarian Village.

steps.player: I guess I can go to the Barbarian Village.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Wonderful, I'd really appreciate it!

options.text: Talk about One Small Favour.

steps.player: What about the breathing salts?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: I smashed the pot which held them, remember?

steps.player: Oh yes...where am I going to get a new pot?

options.text: Talk about One Small Favour.

steps.text: If the player has lost the herbal tincture:

steps.player: I've lost that herbal tincture you gave me!

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: No problem, I'll just rustle up another one for you.

steps.player: What was I supposed to be doing again?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Go and see Tassie in the Barbarian Village about making an airtight pot for me to store my breathing salts in, then you can take some for Horvik.

steps.player: Oh, yes right!

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.player: Hey there...I need an airtight pot just as soon as you can make one!
It's a matter of some urgency that I have an airtight container as soon as possible!

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: Who on earth do you think you are coming in here demanding an airtight pot...Can't you see that I have my own worries to think about?

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.player: Oh, sorry, I didn't think...what's the problem?

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: Well, if you must know, I'm working all the hours that Saradomin sends, I have to in order to make enough money to pay that loan shark Hammerspike!

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.player: Loan shark? Hammerspike? What are you talking about?

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: I took over this abandoned pottery place with a loan from Hammerspike. He's demanding payment and I can barely just make the interest payments.

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: I'm working as hard as I can but I'll never pay the loan off at this rate!

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.player: But I need an airtight pot...to store breathing salts in.

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: Well, that may be, but I have a rush order for a top paying customer that's going to keep Hammerspike off my back for a bit.

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: If you really want that pot, you're going to have to deal with Hammerspike in the dwarven mines!

options.text: Ok, I'll deal with Hammerspike!

steps.player: Ok, I'll deal with Hammerspike!

steps.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
steps.text: Really, you will?

steps.player: Yes, I'll go and have a chat with him, perhaps we can sort something out.

steps.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
steps.text: Well, that would be really great...I just hope he doesn't grind you into flour to make his bread, he's one of the most ruthless gangsters in the area.

steps.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
steps.text: Beware, his guards are incredibly loyal, they'll slit their own throats to protect him!

steps.player: That's not a pretty picture you're painting, but don't worry, I'll be careful. Now, where do I find this Hammerspike?

steps.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
steps.text: He's in the dwarven mines somewhere, not sure exactly where though.

options.text: No, sorry, no more blooming favours for anyone!

steps.player: No, sorry, no more blooming favours for anyone!

steps.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
steps.text: Oh, well that's a real shame, I was hoping you could have sorted out that Hammerspike for me once and for all!

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: So I see. What's the problem? Did you sort out Hammerspike?

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.player: Not exactly, can you tell me what I'm supposed to do again?

the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.speaker: Tassie Slipcast
the-various-favours-are-asked-tassie-s-r.text: Go talk to Hammerspike in the Dwarven mines and see if you can get him to leave me alone...I won't be able to make you the airtight pot else.

options.text: I'm looking for Hammerspike.

steps.player: I'm looking for Hammerspike.

steps.speaker: Dwarf gang member
steps.text: Well, he's around here somewhere, just use your eyes, I'm sure you'll get there one day.

options.text: What're you doing here?
Who do you work for?
Ok, thanks.

the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.text: And who da heck are you?

the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.player: I'm [player name] and I want to talk to you about a friend of mine, Tassie Slipcast. She says you're putting the screws on her for some loan she had from you. Is this true?

the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.text: And what if it is? Tassie got into an arrangement that is mutually beneficial, as far as I understood it, she was happy with the deal.

options.text: Well, I've come to change the deal!

steps.player: Well, I've come to change the deal!

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Oh, so you wanna give me something for leaving Tassie alone?

steps.player: Er...er...not exactly...why can't you just leave her alone? I mean, make a nice gesture, I'm asking out as a favour...please?

options.text: Can't you just leave Tassie alone?

steps.player: Can't you just leave Tassie alone?

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Where would I be if I just left all of my 'customers' alone? Some people just need an extra 'encouragement' to make the best out of life...I'm just helping them along.

options.text: Oh, come on...do something nice for Tassie.

steps.player: Oh, come on...do something nice for a Tassie. Think about how hard she's working!

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Well...now that you come to mention it, I guess I have been a little hard on the girl.

steps.player: Yeah, come on give her a break.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: And I guess I am quite stressed about things, what with so much to think about recently.

steps.player: I can understand that...you have a lot on your mind. Go on, make a change...it'll do you good! There must be something else that you wanted to do at least once in your life.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Hmm, yes, yes you're right...I did want to do something, something I noticed recently, but you'll laugh if I tell you...nah, it's silly.

options.text: Have you always been a gangster?

steps.player: Have you always been a gangster? Wasn't there anything else that you wanted to do instead? Come on, tell me what you want to do...I'm listening.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Well, I was just thinking the other day that I'm feeling sort of unfulfilled in my life.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: I'd like to get rid of all this anger and frustration that my current lifestyle brings and do something relaxing...like those druids, I mean, all day sitting around, looking at herbs and wearing robes and stuff.

steps.player: Ok, that sounds good.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, I really want to be a druid...so...go and see the druid leader, I think Sanfew is his name, and persuade him to take me as an initiate. Do me this one small favour and I'll leave Tassie alone.

options.text: I don't think they take dwarven gangsters as initiates.

steps.player: I don't think they take dwarven gangsters as initiates.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Whatever...I guess Tassie's gonna be working hard for a bit longer yet then!

options.text: Ok, another favour...I think I can manage that.

steps.player: Ok, another favour...I think I can manage that.

steps.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
steps.text: Good...I mean great! Come back when Sanfew has agreed to take me as an initiate!

steps.speaker: Dwarf gang member
steps.text: Ha ha ha ha! Good one boss, I can't believe [he/she/they] fell for that, boss!

options.text: Ok, thanks.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.player: What was it that I was supposed to do for you?

the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.speaker: Hammerspike Stoutbeard
the-various-favours-are-asked-dealing-wi.text: Go and talk to Sanfew and get him to accept me as a druid initiate!

options.text: Are you taking any new initiates?

steps.player: Are you taking any new initates?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Hmmm, are you considering yourself?

options.text: How does someone become an initate?

steps.player: How does someone become an initate?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Hmm, it's quite a straight-forward process. A person, perhaps like yourself, comes along to me and asks.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: We test your knowledge of Herblore and see if you can fit in with the rest of us. If you pass, then we let you become an initiate.

steps.player: Seems pretty straight forward!

options.text: Do you accept dwarves?

steps.player: Do you accept dwarves?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Dwarves? Well now, that's a mighty interesting question... Just because we haven't before, doesn't mean to say that we shouldn't.

options.text: A dwarf I know wants to become an initiate.

steps.player: A dwarf I know wants to become an initiate.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Oh yes? Well, that's interesting. Let me think for a moment. Hmmm... yes, actually, I don't mind taking him on, so long as you can do me just one small favour. Well, two actually.

steps.player: Not you as well?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Stop interrupting me. I haven't told you about these favours!

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: There's a poor little gnome up on White Wolf mountain. I wondered if you could take him a warming herbal brew. I have the recipe here!

steps.player: Well, that seems simple enough.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: In addition...

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: I've long wished to take a trip down to see those ogres to the south of Yanille, and bring the word of Guthix to them. I was hoping you might organise this trip with the gnome pilot up there on White Wolf mountain.

steps.player: Are you mad?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Well, perhaps a bit... but it's never stopped you doing things for me before.

steps.player: I've been asked to do a lot of favours recently.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Well, that's the life of an adventurer. Is it a deal, or not?

options.text: Yep, it's a deal.

steps.player: Yep, it's a deal. Tell me the recipe for this herbal tea.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Ok, you need to heat some water up in a bowl, then pour it into an empty teacup. Add 1 harralander, 2 guam and 1 marrentill...it'll warm that poor fellow up a treat!

steps.player: Mmm, sounds delicious! What's it called?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: We call it 'Guthix's rest'.

steps.player: Can I drink it?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: If you want!

steps.player: Great! And thanks.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: But you'll have to make another one for the gnome.

steps.player: But I can drink it though.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Yes, but you'll have to make another one for the gnome.

steps.player: Ok, I think I understand.

options.text: Nope, it's not a deal!

steps.player: Nope, it's not a deal!

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Well, that's a shame. I was looking forward to visiting the ogres... Perhaps someday I will.

options.text: Ok, thanks.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

options.text: What did you need me to do again?

steps.player: What did you need me to do again?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Make a herbal tea for the gnome and persuade him to take me to the ogre area, down to the south!

steps.player: Oh yes, right, thanks!

options.text: How do I make the tea again?

steps.player: How do I make the tea again?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Ok, you need to heat some water up in a bowl, then pour it into an empty teacup. Add 1 harralander, 2 guam and 1 marrentill...it'll warm that poor fellow up a treat!

steps.player: Oh yes, right, thanks!

options.text: Ok, thanks.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

options.text: Chat about Gliders
Sanfew asked me to come and talk to you.

the-various-favours-are-asked-talking-to.player: Sanfew asked me to come and talk to you.

the-various-favours-are-asked-talking-to.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
the-various-favours-are-asked-talking-to.text: Brrr, blimey it's cold up here! Wish I had something nice to drink to chase away these chills!

options.text: Chat about Gliders
I have a special tea here for you from Sanfew!

steps.player: I have a special tea here for you from Sanfew!

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Ohhh! Many thanks! Brrr, blimey it's cold up here!
(Guthix rest tea is removed from the inventory.)

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Blimey, it was certainly jolly decent of that old stick Sanfew to get you to make me a cup of herbal tea. Wow! It really does chase away the chills!

steps.player: Yes, he's quite considerate that way...you know, thinking of people. In fact, he was thinking that you may be able to help him with another little 'helping' situation that involves ogres.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Ogres!

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Hmmm, well I guess they're just like overgrown gnomes when you think about it!

steps.player: More like 'super-over-grown-gnomes' if you ask me! Or 'overgrown humans'!

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Quite! Anyway, go on! What was Sanfew after?

steps.player: Sanfew wants to bring the word of Guthix to those ogres, though I've no idea if ogres have the mental ability to grasp druidic concepts.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Yes, quite, but who amongst us does? I know I'm often confused by that beardy bunch of yakking druids.

steps.player: Well, he wants to know if he can organise a glider ride down there.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Hmm, interesting! I know that the elders want to extend the network of glider routes, and I did hear that the Feldip Hills were being considered. I don't know why it hasn't opened up yet though.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: If I'm going to transport that yakking druid down to the ogres I'll want to make it in record time so I'll need some lighter kit.

steps.player: Ok, good luck with that.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: There's a chap called Arhein in Catherby and I've heard that his special interest in ships has helped him to produce lightweight but strengthened ropes. I'm in need of some T.R.A.S.H.! And I need you to get it for me.

steps.player: TRASH? What the demonikin are you talking about? Why do I have to get it?

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: I'm talking about the next generation of lightweight ropes. Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser...T.R.A.S.H.! I'll transport your yakking druid if you can get me some T.R.A.S.H!

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: And you have to get it because I have to stay here with this glider. Is it a deal?

options.text: What do you want me to do?

steps.player: What do you want me to do?

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Go to Arhein and ask him for some T.R.A.S.H....

options.text: What is T.R.A.S.H?

steps.player: What is T.R.A.S.H?

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: T.R.A.S.H. is a short way of saying, 'Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser', it's a technical term that we gnomes like to use when specifying lightweight rope.

options.text: Where can I get this from?

steps.player: Where can I get this from?

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Go and talk to a chap called Arhein in Catherby, he's developed it so he'll know exactly what you're talking about.

steps.player: Great! So I get to talk T.R.A.S.H with shopkeepers!

options.text: Ok, I'll go and get you some T.R.A.S.H.

steps.player: Ok, I'll go and get you some T.R.A.S.H.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Wonderful my friend, wonderful!

options.text: No, sorry, I can't do it right now.

steps.player: No, sorry, I can't do it right now.

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Well, that's a bit of a shame...I was looking forward to upgrading my glider!

options.text: Chat about Gliders
How was that tea?

steps.player: How was that tea?

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: It was delicious thanks!

options.text: What am I supposed to be doing again?

steps.player: What am I supposed to be doing again?

steps.speaker: Captain Bleemadge
steps.text: Go to Arhein in Catherby and get some T.R.A.S.H! That's a short name for Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser and then bring it back to me! I mean, it's not difficult is it?

the-various-favours-are-asked-talking-t-.speaker: Arhein
the-various-favours-are-asked-talking-t-.text: Hello! Would you like to trade?

options.text: Yes.
No thank you.
Is that your ship?
I need to talk T.R.A.S.H. to you.

steps.player: I need to talk T.R.A.S.H. to you.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Oh yes, well it won't be the first time...but just so I'm sure can you explain what you mean?

steps.player: Yes, of course. There's a Gnome on White Wolf mountain who needs some T.R.A.S.H...for his glider...do you have some?

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Well, I've done a lot of research into Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawsers and it seems to have paid off, but answer me this one question. Why are you asking me this rather than the Gnome?

steps.player: Well, I'm sort of doing him a favour.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: Hmm, really, is that so? Well, I do have some Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser and I'll let you have some if you do me just one small favour.

steps.player: How totally unpredictable!

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: No, this is a really quick thing and shouldn't take you longer than a few minutes.

steps.player: Yeah, I've heard that before! Go on...tell me anyway.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: I'm funding a rather expensive trade run to Brimhaven soon and I want to be sure that the weather isn't going to change and cause my ships any trouble.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: The last thing I need is a load of goods going straight to the bottom of the ocean.

steps.player: Well, I can understand that.

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: I just need you to pop along to Seers Village and ask those philosophers of foresight for a weather report. I believe a new seer there called Phantuwti can help you.

options.text: No way...I've had enough of this wild goose chase.

steps.player: No way...I've had enough of this wild goose chase.

options.text: Yes, Ok, I'll do it!

steps.player: Yes, Ok, I'll do it!

steps.speaker: Arhein
steps.text: That's great, many thanks.

options.text: Hello, what is this place?
What do you do here?
Do you have any quests?
Hi, can you give me a weather forecast?

steps.player: Hi, can you give me a weather forecast?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Hmm, somehow I knew you were going to ask me that...strange...life is so predictable when you have the power of foresight.

steps.player: Great! So I can assume you've been really pro-active and compiled an up-to-date one for me?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Alas my presumptuous friend, the power of foresight and the impulse to act is quite similar to the interplay between intelligence and wisdom.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: One might have intelligence enough to realise that cakes are bad for us, but we may not have the wisdom to stop cramming that delicious-looking fatty cream cake into our salivating mouth.

steps.player: So, in your case, you have the power of foresight, but you're too lazy to act on it?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Not exactly lazy...but unable. My abilities and concern have been focused on the fate of a local girl whose association with a certain wizard has landed her between a rock and hard place.

options.text: Who is this girl that you're concerned about?

steps.player: Who is this girl that you're concerned about?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: The girl's name is Petra, she's a very ...energetic youngster, always wanted to travel and have adventures. When she turned seventeen she set off to earn herself fame and fortune.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: It looks like she's ended up in a bit of a dead end position...

options.text: Where is this girl?

steps.player: Where is this girl?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: It's quite difficult to pinpoint exactly where she is, but apparently she's in some sort of cavern structure.

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: We sense that there are other beings around her, smelly creatures, and some sort of presence is watching over her.

steps.player: Do you have any ideas where that might be? I mean, it's pretty vague isn't it?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Well, we believe it may be some sort of nearby cave, it can't be very far away as the impressions we get are quite strong. We believe the cave is a home for some sort of creature or creatures.

options.text: What do you think needs to be done?

steps.player: What do you think needs to be done?

steps.speaker: Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight
steps.text: Well, it would be nice to locate her...if possible. Then we may be able to work out what to do when we can see what sort of state she's in.
